notes: Random object packets; the object lookup (0x7489c) finds it or not; its owner is the local marker (also with the high byte set), 0xff or a track index 0..7, taken over by the sender or kept; the slot word in EDX has random high bits; the track flags are zero or not; the end-of-track id is -1 or not; the update callees (0x73ee0, 0x724a8) are stubs logging their arguments.
